<div class="card-body">
'''Stunning Leader''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">気絶に陥るリーダー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">屋内の位置カードで戦闘が宣言された直後に使用する。1フォース消費して、双方の側のすべてのリーダーと能力値＞2のキャラクターを完全にその戦闘から切り離す。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Stunning-Leader-SWCA-67793.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ストームトルーパーは重要な目標を殺さずにスタン（気絶）させる訓練を受けている。これは敵軍を分断し、リーダーを捕まえて尋問するためである。スタンに後遺症はなく、その後の尋問にも支障は出ない。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Stunning Leader.

'''Card text:'''
Play immediately after a battle is declared at an interior location card. Spend 1 Force to cut all leaders and characters with ability greater than 2 on both sides completely out of that battle.

'''Lore:'''
Stormtroopers train to stun, not kill, priority targets, to split the enemy and capture leaders for interrogation. Stun has no aftereffects and does not hinder later interrogation.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Title is 気絶に陥るリーダー.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Stunning Leader]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
